source.access: Read-only SQL through the supplied session pooler

location_in_dbeaver: Databases > postgres > Schemas > prod > Functions > get_player_throw_directions

inputs.p_year: Optional year, default NULL includes all years

grouping.centerAngle_note: Despite the key name, the returned angle is the bucket lower edge, not its midpoint
grouping.receiving_angle: Uses the same throw_angle as the throwing count; this database function does not rotate it by 180 degrees

filters.year: First four characters of GameID, when a year is supplied

output: JSON with buckets containing label, centerAngle, throwerCount and receiverCount, plus role totals
verification: Executed for aatkins, 2026, 12; each role total and bucket sum reconciled to a separate read-only query of prod.throws
limits: The function returns counts, not a finished diagram or image.
Chart orientation, radial scaling, colours and website usage were not verified from frontend source.
No website files or database data were changed.
